title: View from Shamrock Tacos
content: The best tacos in Texas are at Shamrock Tacos, tucked away in the gas station in Wimberley.From the picnic table outside, I'm looking at Hill Country Tire and Automotive. I love the bright Texas sun, and the details of the white car and the truck parked across the empty parking lot.I lay a light warm color across the scene and refine the areas, going from transparent to opaque and from large areas to small details. (Link to video).---Deadline is November 7 for thePaint a Cell Tower Challenge. Check it out on Facebook.I'm usingM.
